extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax payable before application for grant of probate
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an illiquid St Albans estate valued at about £1,082,500 enquires about borrowing £67,500 to pay the inheritance tax due before the grant can be applied for.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding the St Albans estate; we have received the details and registered it for review. To take matters further we would need confirmation of the date of death and the names of the executors, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, the IHT computation or IHT400 figures, and confirmation of whether any other borrowing or charges affect the estate. We will also need identification and verification documents for the executors and confirmation of your firm's involvement. Nothing in this message constitutes an offer of finance or an indication of terms. A member of our team will be in touch once the information above has been received.
